shots.focal_element: Inside of the headset facial interface: two lens openings framed by knit fabric padding, symmetric around a small center sensor
shots.what_happens: A symmetric, dark product render looks into the headset through its lenses toward a soft pastel sky; the camera slowly pushes in so the fabric texture of the padding becomes readable over the roughly one-second shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Render the headset interior head-on in a 3D scene with a pastel gradient backdrop behind the lenses and animate a 1 s camera dolly-in of about 10 percent scale with an ease-out curve.

shots.focal_element: Macro detail of the dark knit fabric on the headset padding curving across the frame against a pastel gradient
shots.what_happens: A macro render sweeps along the curved knit padding with shallow depth of field; by the second sampled frame (0:14.5) the picture already shows the white woven head strap arching against the same pastel sky, so the shot appears to contain a quick material-detail sequence.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a macro 3D close-up of a textured fabric surface diagonal across the frame with a shallow depth-of-field blur and a slow lateral camera drift of about 0.6 s, on a pink-to-blue gradient background.

shots.focal_element: A woman wearing the white headset dancing/playing in a warm-lit living room, with a large glowing white letter overlaid on her torso
shots.typography: Single oversized white sans-serif capital letter with a soft glow/motion blur; it is the first visible glyph of the kinetic word PLAY that completes in s009.
shots.what_happens: The keyframe still shows the white head strap render, while the 0:15.0 contact-sheet frame shows lifestyle footage of a player lunging in a living room as a glowing letter flies in; the cut from product render to lifestyle footage happens inside this short shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard cut from the strap render to handheld lifestyle footage and fly a single large white capital letter in with a scale-down plus motion blur over 0.3 s, centered on the subject.

shots.focal_element: The player in the headset in a living room, with the scattered letters PLAY resolving into the caption 'Play in maximum comfort'
shots.typography: First, oversized white uppercase sans-serif letters P-L-A-Y scattered at different sizes and offsets; then a centered single-line caption in a bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, normal tracking, white with no box. Font guess (low confidence): Meta's Optimistic Display.
shots.what_happens: Big kinetic letters spelling PLAY float over the dancing player, blur away and are replaced by the centered caption 'Play in maximum comfort', which blurs in word by word (the keyframe shows 'in maximum comfort' still semi-transparent). The shot ends on black, with the next caption 'game-changing performance' already arriving as a horizontal streak.
shots.build_rebuild: Over full-bleed footage, animate four oversized uppercase letters in with staggered scale and offset, blur them out, then blur-in a centered white bold sans caption word by word with 80 ms stagger and hold it for about 1 s before cutting to black.

shots.focal_element: A gold Snapdragon-branded chip on a dark circuit board that lights up with blue and orange traces
on_screen_text: Graphics performance of next-gen Snapdragon chip vs. Meta Quest 2 chip.
shots.typography: Main captions are centered white bold geometric sans-serif in sentence case with normal tracking; the transition between captions uses a horizontal motion-streak blur. 'Snapdragon' is the brand wordmark printed on the chip. The disclaimer is a small light-weight sans-serif footnote centered at the bottom.
shots.what_happens: 'Enjoy game-changing performance' sits over a dark, blurred circuit environment; the caption smears away horizontally as a tilted gold Snapdragon chip swings into view. The camera settles on the chip while the board's traces light up in blue and orange, the caption 'Double the GPU processing power' appears in front of it, and a footnote explains the comparison basis.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centered caption over a dark defocused 3D board, wipe it out with a horizontal motion-blur streak while a tilted chip model rotates to near-flat with an ease-out, then light circuit traces outward with an emissive glow and fade in the second caption plus a small bottom footnote.

shots.focal_element: First-person VR gameplay in a desert canyon (player hands holding a whip and a glowing blade, enemies ahead) under the centered caption
shots.typography: Centered white bold geometric sans-serif caption in sentence case; at 0:22.0 the letters of 'smoother experiences' are still rising into place and blurred. 'Higher Resolution Displays' (title case, same family, smaller) appears at the shot's tail over the lens render.
shots.what_happens: In-game footage plays as the caption 'Faster and smoother experiences' assembles letter by letter with a blur and vertical offset, then holds while the player swings a blade; by 0:24.0 the frame has returned to the headset lens render with the caption 'Higher Resolution Displays'.
shots.build_rebuild: Play full-bleed gameplay capture and reveal a centered white caption per character with a 20 px rise, blur-to-sharp and 25 ms stagger, holding it for about 1.5 s before a hard cut to the next product render.
